# deps-change

## Why
Pins the s37 `execution-graph-topology` declared-dependency extraction against the
shapes the real `openspec/changes/**` corpus actually uses — an in-row marker, a
marker in a wrapped continuation line, a separated reference list, an unresolvable
reference, and the prose that must NOT be read as a dependency.

## What Changes
- nothing; this dir exists only as a plan-import fixture
